title: SCREEN Holdings
summary: Japanese supplier of wafer-cleaning and coating/developing equipment.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

SCREEN Holdings makes batch and single-wafer cleaning tools and coat/develop tracks that apply and develop photoresist. Cleaning steps multiply at advanced nodes, and its tracks are paired with leading-edge scanners. The company also has graphic-arts and display equipment businesses.

Technology Exposure

  • Single-wafer and batch cleaning
  • Coat and develop tracks
  • Display and graphic-arts equipment

What To Watch

  • Cleaning intensity per node
  • Leading-edge fab capex
  • Display equipment demand

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
